turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 60-year-old woman, and about 30 minutes ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It was painless, and my left eye feels normal.

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, I do smoke—about 10 cigarettes a day. I’ve been smoking for a while, and I drink alcohol only occasionally.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nausea or stomach upset lately.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or masses, and I don’t have any pain there.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling overall. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or emotional strain in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I wouldn’t say I’ve been under significant stress or emotional strain lately, and I don’t feel especially overwhelmed. My main issue is that sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, such as it appearing darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any change in the color of my urine—it looks about the same as usual.”
